# swift-macro: freestanding macros, attributes and rust attributes applied to a source expression.
# a `#name` or `@Name` head, or a `#[` / `#![` attribute, applies to the balanced group after it,
# and the syntax exemption reads the head and its group as one expression. every identifier inside
# the group is still checked, so an opaque token in an argument keeps the line reported.
# known gap: a macro call left open at the line end after a bare argument, the first line of a
# multi-line `#expect(` whose comparison continues on the next line, is still reported, because an
# open call is accepted only when its tail breaks after an opener, a separator or a closed group.

        #expect(profile.displayName.localizedUppercase(.current))

        #expect(settings.transitionAnimations(.disabled))
        #require(store.workspaces.first?.selectedSessionIdentifier)
        #expect(Session(identifier: sessionName).displayTitle(forWindow: 2) == expectedTitle)
